title: Control provider data policy and evaluated fallbacks
objective: Only approved public evidence reaches an explicitly selected model endpoint.
outcome: A changed or unavailable model enters review; a latest alias cannot replace the evaluated model unnoticed. Excluded material never reaches the fake network transport; logging does not reintroduce it. A privacy-incompatible fallback is refused even when cheaper; an unevaluated free router does not become the default. Muse Contributor data-use terms are explicit in the operator configuration. No source URL, endpoint or provider is selected from untrusted document instructions.

commits.subject: Snapshot model and endpoint capabilities
commits.instructions: Read the public catalog and provider endpoint metadata at configuration time. Store exact model IDs, prices/overrides, supported parameters and data-use policy version.
commits.verification: A changed or unavailable model enters review; a latest alias cannot replace the evaluated model unnoticed.

commits.subject: Enforce evidence eligibility
commits.instructions: Accept approved public documentation captures only. Reject secrets, private queries, restricted content and unapproved contributor transmission using the collection classification.
commits.verification: Fixtures ensure excluded material never reaches the fake network transport; logging does not reintroduce it.

commits.subject: Implement a bounded fallback policy
commits.instructions: Allow only evaluated models/providers with equal-or-stricter data policy and an accepted maximum price. Record the actual selection for each attempt.
commits.verification: A privacy-incompatible fallback is refused even when cheaper; an unevaluated free router does not become the default.
